_about: v3 (Batch D Round 2). Same rules as v2: a retrieval hit = any top-k chunk whose text contains ANY anchor (case-insensitive, whitespace-collapsed); parts=true means the anchors are different pieces of ONE answer. v2 is untouched. CAUTION, written into the file on purpose: questions with author='assistant' were written by the assistant WITH the corpus visible, so they are NOT blind and probably flatter keyword search; author='owner' questions were written by the project owner from memory. The answer key (anchors) was written before any retrieval was run and was checked only for presence in the corpus, never against a ranking. The corpus is the frozen older snapshot, so answers follow the corpus, not the live docs (e.g. it says Developers see only their own notes; the live system changed that in ADR-0023). Owner questions NOT scored because they are judgment or advice and have no corpus answer beyond partial mentions: 'is guardrail of any use in the professional or business world...' and 'what things in this project can the developer use during a technical or hr interview'. P20 (owner) is ambiguous: 'notes they ingested' mixes notes and documents; it is anchored on the default-Admin-only evidence for new documents.
